# smart-base-house-processes

The BPMN this layer owns as house processes, under `content/` (as against `methodologies/processes/`, which holds methodologies adopted from the corpus): `l2-dak-authoring.bpmn`, whose tracks each call `l2-component-edit-review.bpmn` (the agent edits, checks, renders and stages one component while a person in its reviewing role reviews it alongside, never as a gate); `smart-guideline-end-to-end.bpmn`, use case to consuming application through the L1 KG, L2 and L3, with adjudication as QA rather than a gate, calling `l2-dak-authoring.bpmn` and `dak-l3-ig.bpmn` for its L2 and L3 stages; `dth-authoring.bpmn`, a Digital Transformation Handbook from sources to publication in seven stages, each ending in a milestone recorded on the work plan; `SGAuthoring.DAKLifecycle.bpmn`; `classify-and-code-content.bpmn`; and two point-of-care processes any DAK calls by call activity, `questionnaire-data-capture.bpmn` (a health worker completes an SDC form, the system extracts its resources) and `act-on-decision-support.bpmn` (the system applies a PlanDefinition, the health worker accepts or declines, may note why on a branch nothing waits for, and the care plan is updated). [Skill](https://litlfred.github.io/bootstrap/schemas/#skill) refs this layer does not own resolve down through `fhir-harness`. cat-harness-tools' `render:bpmn` draws each beside its source (bean folio-assistant-akiq); folio-assistant's just-the-docs site, which mounts this directory, shows them.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-house-processes`, holding `processes`.
